test_title: PYST 4: Selection Post (Matric Level) - GA (Held On 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which are the sectors have been targeted for improvements by GOI's AMRUT scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Urban infrastructure**__.

**__Key Points__**

__

• **Rural employment** is the primary focus of the **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)**, which was enacted in **2005** to provide a legal guarantee for at least **100 days** of wage employment in every financial year to adult members of any rural household. ***Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.***

• **Urban infrastructure** is the core sector targeted by the **Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT)**. The mission aims to ensure that every household has access to a tap with a reliable supply of **water** and a **sewerage** connection. ***Hence, statement 2 is correct.***

• **Agricultural productivity** is addressed through various other schemes such as the **Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)**, launched in **2015**, which focuses on expanding cultivable areas under assured irrigation and improving on-farm water use efficiency. ***Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.***

• **Renewable energy** initiatives in **India** are managed under the **National Solar Mission** and other programs led by the **Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)** to promote sustainable power sources. ***Hence, statement 4 is incorrect.***

• The **AMRUT** scheme was launched by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** in **June 2015** with the objective of improving the quality of life for all, especially the poor and the disadvantaged, by providing basic services and building amenities in cities.

• ***Hence, the correct answer is Urban infrastructure__.***

**__Additional Information__**

__

• **AMRUT 2.0:**

• Launched in **October 2021**, **AMRUT 2.0** aims to make cities **'water secure'** and provide functional tap connections to all households in all **4,700 statutory towns**.

• It targets **100% coverage** of sewage and septage management in **500 AMRUT cities**.

• The mission promotes the **circular economy** of water through the development of **City Water Balance Plans (CWBP)**.

• **Funding and Implementation:**

• The scheme is a **Centrally Sponsored Scheme** where the **Government of India** provides financial assistance to states and **Urban Local Bodies (ULBs)**.

• For cities with a population of up to **10 lakh**, the central assistance is **one-third** of the project cost, while for cities with a population above **10 lakh**, it is **one-fourth**.

• The **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)** is the nodal ministry responsible for the overall implementation and monitoring of the mission.

• **Urban Reforms:**

• The mission encourages **ULBs** to implement reforms such as **e-Governance**, professionalization of municipal cadres, and improving **credit ratings**.

• Improved credit ratings allow cities to raise funds through **Municipal Bonds** for large-scale infrastructure projects.

**Important Points__**

• **Coverage Criteria:** The mission covers **500 cities**, including all cities and towns with a population of over **one lakh** as per the **2011 Census**, notified municipalities, and certain capital cities.

• **Service Level Benchmarks (SLBs):** The progress of the mission is measured using **SLBs**, which track the performance of cities in providing essential services like **water supply**, **sewerage**, and **drainage**.

• **State Annual Action Plans (SAAP):** States are required to prepare a **SAAP**, which is a consolidated plan of all city-level projects. This allows for a **cooperative federalism** approach where states have more flexibility in project selection.

• **Green Spaces:** A mandatory component of the mission is to increase the **amenity value** of cities by developing at least one **park** or **green space** every year in each of the **500 cities**, specifically catering to the needs of children and senior citizens.

• **Synergy with Other Missions:** **AMRUT** works in close coordination with the **Smart Cities Mission**, **Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban)**, and **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban)** to ensure comprehensive urban development across the country.
